Proposition
[Train-track approximation] 1. 9.7.2\group thurston.ch09.realizationsSource: thurston:page-0278Source: thurston:page-0279 Every essentially complete lamination admits a sequence of train tracks carrying it, with complementary regions and transverse weights converging to the lamination; the associated coordinate charts exhaust the relevant projective lamination space.
